title: Temperature Sensor Reading Explorer
description: A TMP36 reports volts, not degrees -- watch the conversion formula fill in with live numbers.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Sensors, Displays, Motors, and Robot Chassis

educational.audience: Students writing their first sensor-reading code

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given an analog sensor voltage, the learner calculates the corresponding temperature using the sensor's linear conversion formula.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Slide the sensor voltage and watch each step of the conversion rebuild itself
pedagogical.assessment: Give a voltage and ask for the temperature before moving the slider there.
